{
  "version": 1,
  "about": "Smart Shop store settings. The app ships with this file and downloads newer signed copies from GitHub. Raise the version and run Tools/publish-store-settings.sh to publish a change.",
  "stores": [
    {
      "id": "Tesco",
      "country": "GB",
      "search": "https://www.tesco.com/shop/en-GB/search?query=",
      "basket": "https://www.tesco.com/shop/en-GB/trolley"
    },
    {
      "id": "Sainsbury's",
      "country": "GB",
      "search": "https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/groceries/search?searchTerm=",
      "basket": "https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/trolley"
    },
    {
      "id": "Asda",
      "country": "GB",
      "search": "https://www.asda.com/groceries/search/",
      "basket": "https://www.asda.com/groceries/trolley"
    },
    {
      "id": "Morrisons",
      "country": "GB",
      "search": "https://groceries.morrisons.com/search?q=",
      "basket": "https://groceries.morrisons.com/basket"
    },
    {
      "id": "Waitrose",
      "country": "GB",
      "search": "https://www.waitrose.com/ecom/shop/search?searchTerm=",
      "basket": "https://www.waitrose.com/ecom/shop/trolley"
    },
    {
      "id": "Ocado",
      "country": "GB",
      "search": "https://www.ocado.com/search?q=",
      "basket": "https://www.ocado.com/basket"
    }
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "skipPromos": [
      "(function () {",
      "  if (window.__ssTimer) { clearInterval(window.__ssTimer); }",
      "  var tries = 0;",
      "  var waited = 0;",
      "  var steady = 0;",
      "  var stop = function () { clearInterval(window.__ssTimer); };",
      "  window.addEventListener('touchmove', stop, { once: true, passive: true });",
      "  window.addEventListener('wheel', stop, { once: true, passive: true });",
      "",
      "  var adverts = ['sponsored', 'featured', 'out of stock', 'currently unavailable'];",
      "",
      "  // The first product tile that is on show, in stock and not an advert. A tile is the biggest",
      "  // container around a single \"Add\" button: any bigger and it would hold other products too.",
      "  var lastAdvert = null;",
      "  var findTile = function () {",
      "    lastAdvert = null;",
      "    var all = document.querySelectorAll('button, a');",
      "    var adds = [];",
      "    for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {",
      "      var label = (all[i].innerText || all[i].textContent || '').trim();",
      "      if (/^add(\\s|$)/i.test(label)) { adds.push(all[i]); }",
      "    }",
      "    var addsInside = function (el) {",
      "      var n = 0;",
      "      for (var k = 0; k < adds.length; k++) { if (el.contains(adds[k])) { n++; } }",
      "      return n;",
      "    };",
      "    for (var a = 0; a < adds.length; a++) {",
      "      var tile = adds[a];",
      "      while (tile.parentElement && tile.parentElement !== document.body) {",
      "        var parent = tile.parentElement;",
      "        if (addsInside(parent) > 1 || parent.getBoundingClientRect().height > 900) { break; }",
      "        tile = parent;",
      "      }",
      "      var box = tile.getBoundingClientRect();",
      "      if (box.width < 40 || box.height < 60) { continue; }",
      "      var text = (tile.innerText || '').toLowerCase();",
      "      var isAdvert = false;",
      "      for (var s = 0; s < adverts.length; s++) { if (text.indexOf(adverts[s]) !== -1) { isAdvert = true; } }",
      "      if (!isAdvert) { return tile; }",
      "      lastAdvert = tile;",
      "    }",
      "    return null;",
      "  };",
      "",
      "  // Fixed or sticky layers on show. Slim bars stuck to the top (some sites stack two, such as an app",
      "  // banner over the search bar) are headers to keep the tile clear of. A layer covering most of the",
      "  // screen is a pop-up (cookie notice, sign-in) and says nothing about where the tile should sit.",
      "  var layers = function () {",
      "    var width = window.innerWidth;",
      "    var height = window.innerHeight;",
      "    var bar = 0;",
      "    var popup = false;",
      "    var inspect = function (y) {",
      "      var below = 0;",
      "      var probe = document.elementFromPoint(width / 2, y);",
      "      while (probe && probe !== document.body) {",
      "        var position = getComputedStyle(probe).position;",
      "        if (position === 'fixed' || position === 'sticky') {",
      "          var rect = probe.getBoundingClientRect();",
      "          if (rect.height > height * 0.5 && rect.width > width * 0.8) {",
      "            popup = true;",
      "          } else if (rect.top <= y + 1) {",
      "            below = Math.max(below, rect.bottom);",
      "          }",
      "        }",
      "        probe = probe.parentElement;",
      "      }",
      "      return below;",
      "    };",
      "    var y = 4;",
      "    for (var step = 0; step < 4; step++) {",
      "      var bottom = inspect(y);",
      "      if (bottom <= y) { break; }",
      "      bar = bottom;",
      "      y = bottom + 2;",
      "    }",
      "    inspect(height / 2);",
      "    return { bar: bar, popup: popup };",
      "  };",
      "",
      "  // Some sites redraw the page after it loads and jump back to the top, so keep the tile in place",
      "  // until it has held still for about a second and a half. While a pop-up is on show, wait for it",
      "  // to be dealt with.",
      "  window.__ssTimer = setInterval(function () {",
      "    tries += 1;",
      "    if (tries > 100) { stop(); return; }",
      "    var cover = layers();",
      "    if (cover.popup) {",
      "      // Waiting for a pop-up doesn't use up the tries, only a longer limit of about a minute.",
      "      tries -= 1;",
      "      waited += 1;",
      "      steady = 0;",
      "      if (waited > 240) { stop(); }",
      "      return;",
      "    }",
      "    var tile = findTile();",
      "    if (!tile) {",
      "      // Every tile on show so far is an advert (lists often load more as you scroll), so move past",
      "      // them and look again.",
      "      if (lastAdvert) {",
      "        var below = lastAdvert.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;",
      "        var edge = cover.bar + 8;",
      "        if (below > edge + 40) { window.scrollTo({ top: window.pageYOffset + below - edge, behavior: 'auto' }); }",
      "      }",
      "      steady = 0;",
      "      return;",
      "    }",
      "    var wanted = cover.bar + 8;",
      "    var top = tile.getBoundingClientRect().top;",
      "    if (Math.abs(top - wanted) <= 24) {",
      "      steady += 1;",
      "      if (steady >= 6) { stop(); }",
      "      return;",
      "    }",
      "    steady = 0;",
      "    window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, window.pageYOffset + top - wanted), behavior: 'auto' });",
      "  }, 250);",
      "})();"
    ],
    "checkout": [
      "(function () {",
      "  // Only the supermarket's own \"checkout\" or \"book a slot\" button, labelled exactly that, on show and",
      "  // enabled. Never anything that pays, places, confirms or orders, or shows a price.",
      "  var wanted = /^(book a slot|choose a slot|book delivery|book a delivery slot|go to checkout|proceed to checkout|continue to checkout|checkout)\\s*[>›→]?$/i;",
      "  var never = /(pay|place|confirm|order|submit|£|\\$|€)/i;",
      "  var nodes = document.querySelectorAll('button, a, [role=\"button\"]');",
      "  for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {",
      "    var node = nodes[i];",
      "    var label = (node.innerText || node.textContent || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim();",
      "    if (label.length > 40 || !wanted.test(label) || never.test(label)) { continue; }",
      "    if (node.disabled || node.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') { continue; }",
      "    var box = node.getBoundingClientRect();",
      "    if (box.width < 40 || box.height < 20) { continue; }",
      "    var style = getComputedStyle(node);",
      "    if (style.visibility === 'hidden' || style.display === 'none' || Number(style.opacity) === 0) { continue; }",
      "    node.click();",
      "    return true;",
      "  }",
      "  return false;",
      "})();"
    ]
  }
}
